changes.title: Helena Foulkes wins Rhode Island Democratic governor primary, NBC News projects
changes.summary: Rhode Island Gov. Dan McKee has lost his Democratic primary to former CVS executive Helena Foulkes, NBC News projects, after facing a significant spending disadvantage and voter discontent with his tenure. NBC News' Steve Kornacki breaks down the numbers.

changes.title: Rhode Island Gov. Dan McKee loses Democratic primary to businesswoman Helena Foulkes
changes.summary: NBC News projects that Foulkes won the Democratic nomination in the blue state, making McKee the first governor to fall in a primary in eight years.

changes.title: Dan McKee becomes first governor in 8 years to lose primary
